 154++C0BE
 155++C0BE              ; UBnkaiatkecm
 156++C0BE              ; Bit	                Description
 157++C0BE              ; 7 -                   AI Enabled Flag
 158++C0BE              ; 6 -                   Ship Visible = ShipOnScreen/NotCloaked (cleared or set by check visible or cloaking override)
 159++C0BE              ; 5 -                   Ship is exploding if set, note if its a missile and one already equeued this will have to linger
 160++C0BE              ;                       linger can be done by not erasing ship unit missile equeue handled
 161++C0BE              ; 4 -                   Ship marked as exploded, cleared once aknowledged then bit 5 takes over and UBnKCloudCounter
 162++C0BE              ; 3 -                   Display state - Plot as a Dot
 163++C0BE              ; 2 -                   Nbr of Missiles bit 2
 164++C0BE              ; 1 -                   Nbr of Missiles bit 1
 165++C0BE              ; 0 -                   ECM present flag
 166++C0BE              ; ShipNewBitsAddr (in blueprint)
 167++C0BE              ;Bit	                Description
 168++C0BE              ;#0	Trader flag         * 0 = not a trader  * 1 = trader
 169++C0BE              ;                       80% of traders are peaceful and mind their own business plying their trade between the planet and space station, but 20% of them moonlight as bounty hunters (see bit #1)
 170++C0BE              ;                       Ships that are traders: Escape pod, Shuttle, Transporter, Anaconda, Rock hermit, Worm
 171++C0BE              ;#1 Bounty hunter flag  * 0 = not a bounty hunter* 1 = bounty hunter
 172++C0BE              ;                       If we are a fugitive or a serious offender and we bump into a bounty hunter, they will become hostile and attack us (see bit #2)
 173++C0BE              ;                       Ships that are bounty hunters: Viper, Fer-de-lance
 174++C0BE              ;#2	Hostile flag        * 0 = not hostile  * 1 = hostile
 175++C0BE              ;                       Hostile ships will attack us on sight; there are quite a few of them
 176++C0BE              ;                       Ships that are hostile: Sidewinder, Mamba, Krait, Adder, Gecko, Cobra Mk I, Worm, Cobra Mk III, Asp Mk II, Python (pirate), Moray, Thargoid, Thargon, Constrictor
 177++C0BE              ;#3	Pirate flag         * 0 = not a pirate * 1 = pirate
 178++C0BE              ;                       Hostile pirates will attack us on sight, but once we get inside the space station safe zone, they will stop
 179++C0BE              ;                       Ships that are pirates: Sidewinder, Mamba, Krait, Adder, Gecko, Cobra Mk I, Cobra Mk III, Asp Mk II, Python (pirate), Moray, Thargoid
 180++C0BE              ;#4	Docking flag        * 0 = not docking * 1 = docking
 181++C0BE              ;                       Traders with their docking flag set fly towards the space station to try to dock, otherwise they aim for the planet
 182++C0BE              ;                       This flag is randomly set for traders when they are spawned
 183++C0BE              ;                       Ships that can be docking: Escape pod, Shuttle, Transporter, Anaconda, Rock hermit, Worm
 184++C0BE              ;#5	Innocent bystander  * 0 = normal * 1 = innocent bystander
 185++C0BE              ;                       If we attack an innocent ship within the space station safe zone, then the station will get angry with us and start spawning cops
 186++C0BE              ;                       Ships that are innocent bystanders: Shuttle, Transporter, Cobra Mk III, Python, Boa, Anaconda, Rock hermit, Cougar
 187++C0BE              ;#6	Cop flag            * 0 = not a cop * 1 = cop
 188++C0BE              ;                       If we destroy a cop, then we instantly become a fugitive (the Transporter isn't actually a cop, but it's clearly under police protection)
 189++C0BE              ;                       Ships that are cops: Viper, Transporter
 190++C0BE              ;#7	Scooped, docked, escape pod flag
 191++C0BE              ;                       For spawned ships, this flag indicates that the ship been scooped or has docked (bit 7 is always clear on spawning)
 192++C0BE              ;                       For blueprints, this flag indicates whether the ship type has an escape pod fitted, so it can launch it when in dire straits
 193++C0BE              ;                       Ships that have escape pods: Cobra Mk III, Python, Boa, Anaconda, Rock hermit, Viper, Mamba, Krait, Adder, Cobra Mk I, Cobra Mk III (pirate), Asp Mk II, Python (pirate), Fer-de-lance

   2++CE77              ; XX16(1 0)   (3 2)   (5 4)   = sidev_x sidev_y sidev_z XX16(13,12) (15 14) (17 16)
   3++CE77              ; XX16(7 6)   (9 8)   (11 10) = roofv_x roofv_y roofv_z XX16(7 6)   (9 8)   (11 10)
   4++CE77              ; XX16(13 12) (15 14) (17 16) = nosev_x nosev_y nosev_z XX16(1 0)   (3 2)   (5 4)
   5++CE77              ; This moves Side XYZ to position 0, Roof XYZ to position 1 annd nose XYZ to position 2 as a copy of each batch of 6 bytes
   6++CE77              ; 18 byte fast copy
   7++CE77
   8++CE77              ; A straight 18 byte copy (the rotmat and transmat vectors are each 9 contiguous words in the same order). It was a
   9++CE77              ; stack copy (267 T states) under di/ei, but ProcessNodes also runs inside the attract mode interrupt, where that ei
  10++CE77              ; re-enabled interrupts mid handler and let the next one nest. 18 LDIs (308 T states) need no interrupt protection.
  11++CE77                                      ASSERT  UBnkrotmatNosevZ - UBnkrotmatSidevX == 16 && UBnkTransmatNosevZ - UBnkTransmatSidevX == 16
  12++CE77 21 41 C0     CopyRotmatToTransMat:   ld      hl,UBnkrotmatSidevX

1323+ D738              ; Pitch and roll are 2 phases
1324+ D738              ; 1 - we apply our pitch and roll to the ship position
1325+ D738              ;       x -> x + alpha * (y - alpha * x)
1326+ D738              ;       y -> y - alpha * x - beta * z
1327+ D738              ;       z -> z + beta * (y - alpha * x - beta * z)
1328+ D738              ; which can be simplified as:
1329+ D738              ;       1. K2 = y - alpha * x
1330+ D738              ;       2. z = z + beta * K2
1331+ D738              ;       3. y = K2 - beta * z
1332+ D738              ;       4. x = x + alpha * y
1333+ D738              ; 2 - we apply our patch and roll to the ship orientation
1334+ D738              ;      Roll calculations:
1335+ D738              ;
1336+ D738              ;        nosev_y = nosev_y - alpha * nosev_x_hi
1337+ D738              ;        nosev_x = nosev_x + alpha * nosev_y_hi
1338+ D738              ;      Pitch calculations:
1339+ D738              ;
1340+ D738              ;        nosev_y = nosev_y - beta * nosev_z_hi
1341+ D738              ;        nosev_z = nosev_z + beta * nosev_y_hi
1342+ D738

1354+ D994              ; ShipMaxDistance, past the 15 bit range TransposeXX12ByShipToXX15 handles (z >= 32768 read as negative and
1355+ D994              ; clamped to 4), so the full magnitudes are scaled down to 8 bit here and handed straight to ProjectNodeToEye

  14+ C000              CheckRowHLOnScreen:     MACRO   failtarget
  15+ C000 ~                                    ld      a,h                             ; is h byte set, i.e > 256 or < 0
  16+ C000 ~                                    and     a                               ; .
  17+ C000 ~                                    jr      nz,failtarget                   ; h <> 0 so fails (covers <0 and > 255
  18+ C000 ~                                    ld      a,l                             ; l bit 7 0?
  19+ C000 ~                                    and     Bit7Only                        ; covers l > 127 (screen draw area is 0 to 192 / 3 * 2 (128)
  20+ C000 ~                                    jr      nz,failtarget                   ;
  21+ C000                                      ENDM

  33+ C000              SunBankDraw:            MACRO
  34+ C000 ~            .drawLoop               ld      a,(hl)
  35+ C000 ~                                    ld      c,a                     ; c = left column
  36+ C000 ~                                    inc     hl
  37+ C000 ~                                    ld      d,(hl)                  ; d = right col
  38+ C000 ~                                    inc     hl                      ; now ready for next linel
  39+ C000 ~                                    push    hl,,bc
  40+ C000 ~                                    cp      d                       ; if both points are the same then no line (we will ignore single pixel as it can't happen at this stage other than tips of circles)
  41+ C000 ~                                    IfResultZeroGoto .NoLineDraw
  42+ C000 ~                                    ld      a,d                     ; get right col back
  43+ C000 ~                                    sub     c                       ; subtract left so a = length

 514+ C4C4              ; Pitch and roll are 2 phases
 515+ C4C4              ; 1 - we apply our pitch and roll to the ship position
 516+ C4C4              ;       x -> x + alpha * (y - alpha * x)
 517+ C4C4              ;       y -> y - alpha * x - beta * z
 518+ C4C4              ;       z -> z + beta * (y - alpha * x - beta * z)
 519+ C4C4              ; which can be simplified as:
 520+ C4C4              ;       1. K2 = y - alpha * x
 521+ C4C4              ;       2. z = z + beta * K2
 522+ C4C4              ;       3. y = K2 - beta * z
 523+ C4C4              ;       4. x = x + alpha * y
 524+ C4C4              ; 2 - we apply our patch and roll to the ship orientation
 525+ C4C4              ;      Roll calculations:
 526+ C4C4              ;
 527+ C4C4              ;        nosev_y = nosev_y - alpha * nosev_x_hi
 528+ C4C4              ;        nosev_x = nosev_x + alpha * nosev_y_hi
 529+ C4C4              ;      Pitch calculations:
 530+ C4C4              ;
 531+ C4C4              ;        nosev_y = nosev_y - beta * nosev_z_hi
 532+ C4C4              ;        nosev_z = nosev_z + beta * nosev_y_hi
 533+ C4C4

 911+ C733              ;.. Now we caluclate the circle of the star
 912+ C733              ;.. its from MinY down the screen to MaxY center ProjX,ProjY.
 913+ C733              ;.. We can use the circle draw logic gtom Bressenham's algorithm
 914+ C733              ; so now there are the following conditions to consider
 915+ C733              ; y min = 0   y center is negative radius <= ABS (Y center)             => Don't draw
 916+ C733              ; y min = 0   y center is negative radius > ABS (Y center)+1            => Draw bottom half only
 917+ C733              ; y max = 127 y center is > 127    radius <= y center - 127             => Don't draw
 918+ C733              ; y max = 127 y center is > 127    radius > y center - 127              => Draw top half only
 919+ C733              ; y min >= 0  y center > y min     we don't need to worry about radius  => Draw both halves
 920+ C733              ; x center + radius < 0                                                 => Don't draw
 921+ C733              ; x center - radius > 255                                               => Don't draw
 922+ C733              ; we won't consider x more here as the driver is the y coordinate but we will check if x is vaiable
 923+ C733              ; x point = max (x point, 0)   on left
 924+ C733              ; x point = min (x point, 255) on right

 340+ E104 DD 21 38 E0  scan_keyboard:          ld		ix,RawKeys                      ; hl = table of raw IO port readings
 341+ E108 21 42 E0                             ld		hl,KeyAddrTab                   ; de = table of IO ports to read
 342+ E10B 0E 08                                ld		c,8                             ; 8 ports to ready
 343+ E10D 11 00 E0                             ld      de,Keys                         ; ix = table of key states from raw read
 344+ E110 7E           .PortReadLoop:          ld		a,(hl)							; Set up port to read as (hl)$FE
 345+ E111 DB FE                                in		a,($FE)							; read port to a
 346+ E113 DD 77 00                             ld      (ix+0),a                        ; save raw scan
 347+ E116 DD 23                                inc     ix
 348+ E118 23                                   inc		hl                              ; and ready for next read
 349+ E119 06 05        .ProcessInputBits:      ld		b,5								; loop all bits (there are only 5 keys to a group)
 350+ E11B 1F           .ProcessBitsLoop:       rra                                     ; shit bit 0 into carry
 351+ E11C 30 08                                jr      nc,.SetKeyPressed               ; low bit means it was pressed
 352+ E11E FD 6F                                ld      iyl,a
 353+ E120                                      ZeroA
 353+ E120 AF          >                        xor a
 354+ E121 C3 2E E1                             jp      .SetKey
 355+ E124 20 0B                                jr		nz,.SkipKeySet
 356+ E126 FD 6F        .SetKeyPressed:	        ld      iyl,a                           ; save current input byte
 357+ E128 1A                                   ld      a,(de)                          ; get current keystate
 358+ E129 FE 02                                cp      2
 359+ E12B 28 02                                jr      z,.AlreadyHeld
 360+ E12D 3C                                   inc     a                               ; and increment by 1 as its moved from previous state
 361+ E12E 12           .SetKey:                ld		(de),a				  	        ; save key Pressed state
 362+ E12F FD 7D        .AlreadyHeld:           ld      a,iyl                           ; and retrieve the current input byte
 363+ E131 13           .SkipKeySet:	        inc		de								; move to next key
 364+ E132 10 E7                                djnz	.ProcessBitsLoop				; Process all key group bits
 365+ E134 0D                                   dec     c                               ; thats one row of bits all processed
 366+ E135 20 D9                                jr      nz,.PortReadLoop				; Read next input port
 367+ E137              .ReadExtend0:           ; bits are set to 1 for press on the next register
 368+ E137                                      GetNextReg EXTENDED_KEYS_0_REGISTER
 368+ E137 01 3B 24    >            ld bc,$243B
 368+ E13A 3E B0       >            ld a,EXTENDED_KEYS_0_REGISTER
 368+ E13C F3          >            di
 368+ E13D ED 79       >            out (c),a
 368+ E13F 04          >            inc b
 368+ E140 ED 78       >            in a,(c)
 368+ E142 FB          >            ei

 370+ E146 06 08                                ld      b,8
 371+ E148 21 28 E0                             ld      hl,Keys + VK_SEMI
 372+ E14B 5F                                   ld      e,a                             ; e now holds the raw keys for shifting
 373+ E14C CB 13        .ProcessExtend0:        rl      e                               ; shift bits left into carry for extended keys
 374+ E14E 38 04                                jr      c,.SetExtend0KeyPressed         ; if carry they key was pressedw
 375+ E150              .Extend0NotPressed:     ZeroA
 375+ E150 AF          >                        xor a
 376+ E151 C3 5A E1                             jp      .SetExtend0Key
 377+ E154 7E           .SetExtend0KeyPressed:  ld      a,(hl)                          ; consider if key was already held down
 378+ E155 FE 02                                cp      2
 379+ E157 28 02                                jr      z,.Extend0AlreadyHeld
 380+ E159 3C                                   inc     a

 382+ E15B 23           .Extend0AlreadyHeld:    inc     hl
 383+ E15C 10 EE                                djnz    .ProcessExtend0

 384+ E15E 01 3B 24    >            ld bc,$243B
 384+ E161 3E B1       >            ld a,EXTENDED_KEYS_1_REGISTER
 384+ E163 F3          >            di
 384+ E164 ED 79       >            out (c),a
 384+ E166 04          >            inc b
 384+ E167 ED 78       >            in a,(c)
 384+ E169 FB          >            ei
 385+ E16A 32 41 E0                             ld      (RawKeys+9),a                      ; save to extended slot
 386+ E16D 06 08                                ld      b,8
 387+ E16F 21 30 E0                             ld      hl,Keys + VK_DELETE
 388+ E172 5F                                   ld      e,a
 389+ E173 CB 13        .ProcessExtend1:        rl      e                                 ; shift bits left into carry for extended keys

 115+ E101 57                                   ld      d,a             ; we subtract as the tone is the
 116+ E102 1E 0F                                ld      e,15            ; time between pulses
 117+ E104 B7 ED 52                             sub     hl,de
 118+ E107 3E 00                                ld      a,CHANNEL_A_FINE
 119+ E109 01 FD FF                             ld      bc,$FFFD
 120+ E10C ED 79                                out     (c),a
 121+ E10E 06 BF                                ld      b,$BF
 122+ E110 ED 61                                out     (c),h
 123+ E112 3C                                   inc     a
 124+ E113 06 FF                                ld      b,$FF
 125+ E115 ED 79                                out     (c),a
 126+ E117 06 BF                                ld      b,$BF
 127+ E119 ED 69                                out     (c),l
 128+ E11B 3A A4 85     .SetUpNoise:            ld      a,(DELTA)       ; l = DELTA / 4
 129+ E11E CB 3F                                srl     a
 130+ E120 57                                   ld      d,a             ;
 131+ E121 CB 3F                                srl     a
 132+ E123 CB 3F                                srl     a               ; a = DELTA / 8
 133+ E125 C6 1F                                add     a, $1F          ; more noise higher the speed
 134+ E127 06 FF                                ld      b,$FF
 135+ E129 1E 06                                ld      e,NOISE_PERIOD
 136+ E12B ED 59                                out     (c),e
 137+ E12D 06 BF                                ld      b,$BF
 138+ E12F ED 79                                out     (c),a
 139+ E131 7A                                   ld      a,d             ; get back delta / 4
 140+ E132 C6 05                                add     a,5
 141+ E134 CB 3F                                srl     a               ; calculate a scaled from 2 to 7
 142+ E136 1E 08        .EngineOff:             ld      e,CHANNEL_A_AMPLITUDE
 143+ E138 06 FF                                ld      b,$FF
 144+ E13A ED 59                                out     (c),e
 145+ E13C 06 BF                                ld      b,$BF
 146+ E13E ED 79                                out     (c),a
 147+ E140                                      WriteTurboRegister ENVELOPE_PERIOD_FINE,0
 147+ E140 3E 0B       >                        ld      a,ENVELOPE_PERIOD_FINE
 147+ E142             >                        WriteTurboControlA
 147+ E142 01 FD FF    >                        ld      bc,TURBO_SOUND_NEXT_CONTROL
 147+ E145 ED 79       >                        out     (c),a
 147+ E147 06 BF       >                        ld      b,$BF
 147+ E149 3E 00       >                        ld      a,0
 147+ E14B ED 79       >                        out     (c),a
 148+ E14D                                      WriteTurboRegister ENVELOPE_PERIOD_COARSE,0
 148+ E14D 3E 0C       >                        ld      a,ENVELOPE_PERIOD_COARSE
 148+ E14F             >                        WriteTurboControlA
 148+ E14F 01 FD FF    >                        ld      bc,TURBO_SOUND_NEXT_CONTROL
 148+ E152 ED 79       >                        out     (c),a
 148+ E154 06 BF       >                        ld      b,$BF
 148+ E156 3E 00       >                        ld      a,0
 148+ E158 ED 79       >                        out     (c),a
 149+ E15A                                      WriteTurboRegister ENVELOPE_SHAPE,ENVELOPE_SHAPE_SINGLE_ATTACK_HOLD
 149+ E15A 3E 0D       >                        ld      a,ENVELOPE_SHAPE
 149+ E15C             >                        WriteTurboControlA
 149+ E15C 01 FD FF    >                        ld      bc,TURBO_SOUND_NEXT_CONTROL
 149+ E15F ED 79       >                        out     (c),a
 149+ E161 06 BF       >                        ld      b,$BF
 149+ E163 3E 0D       >                        ld      a,ENVELOPE_SHAPE_SINGLE_ATTACK_HOLD
 149+ E165 ED 79       >                        out     (c),a
 150+ E167                                      WriteTurboRegister TONE_ENABLE,   NOISE_CHANNEL_A | NOISE_CHANNEL_B | NOISE_CHANNEL_C
 150+ E167 3E 07       >                        ld      a,TONE_ENABLE
 150+ E169             >                        WriteTurboControlA
 150+ E169 01 FD FF    >                        ld      bc,TURBO_SOUND_NEXT_CONTROL
 150+ E16C ED 79       >                        out     (c),a
 150+ E16E 06 BF       >                        ld      b,$BF
 150+ E170 3E 38       >                        ld      a,NOISE_CHANNEL_A | NOISE_CHANNEL_B | NOISE_CHANNEL_C
 150+ E172 ED 79       >                        out     (c),a
 151+ E174 3A A4 85                             ld      a,(DELTA)
 152+ E177 32 06 B1                             ld      (LAST_DELTA),a
 153+ E17A C9                                   ret
 154+ E17B
 155+ E17B              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 156+ E17B              ; Sound effects. The game asks for one with PlaySFX id (Macros: SoundFxPending[id] = 1, a single store so it is safe
 157+ E17B              ; against this interrupt); each interrupt SfxStartPending starts every pending one on a free channel and SfxStepChannels
 158+ E17B              ; plays one step (tone period and volume) of every running one, so a step is a frame. Channels: AY1 B and C, AY2 A B C,
 159+ E17B              ; AY3 A B C (AY1 A is the engine, UpdateEngineSound). Tones only: InitAudio's mixer has the noise off. A request with
 160+ E17B              ; every channel busy is dropped. (This replaces EnqueSound / PlaySound, whose register numbers were only right for
 161+ E17B              ; channel A, whose channel map had 6 entries for 8 channels, and which nothing ever asked for a sound)
 162+ E17B              SfxChannels             equ 8
 163+ E17B FD           SfxChannelChip:         DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY1
 164+ E17C FD                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY1
 165+ E17D FE                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY2
 166+ E17E FE                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY2
 167+ E17F FE                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY2
 168+ E180 FF                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY3
 169+ E181 FF                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY3
 170+ E182 FF                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY3
 171+ E183 01 02 00 01  SfxChannelVoice:        DB      1, 2, 0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2              ; A = 0, B = 1, C = 2
 171+ E187 02 00 01 02
 172+ E18B 00 00 00...  SfxChannelLeft:         DS      SfxChannels                         ; steps still to play, 0 = free
 173+ E193 00 00 00...  SfxChannelPtr:          DS      SfxChannels * 2                     ; the next step, 0 once silenced
 174+ E1A3 00 00 00...  SfxChannelSilence:      DS      SfxChannels                         ; non 0: the effect just ended, set the volume to 0
 175+ E1AB
 176+ E1AB              ; d = register, a = value on the chip already selected; uses bc
 177+ E1AB 01 FD FF     SfxWriteReg:            ld      bc,TURBO_SOUND_NEXT_CONTROL
 178+ E1AE ED 51                                out     (c),d
 179+ E1B0 06 BF                                ld      b,$BF
 180+ E1B2 ED 79                                out     (c),a
 181+ E1B4 C9                                   ret
 182+ E1B5
 183+ E1B5              ; e = channel: select its chip, d = its voice (0 to 2); uses a, bc, hl
 184+ E1B5 21 7B E1     SfxSelectChannel:       ld      hl,SfxChannelChip
 185+ E1B8 7B                                   ld      a,e
 186+ E1B9 ED 31                                add     hl,a
 187+ E1BB 7E                                   ld      a,(hl)
 188+ E1BC 01 FD FF                             ld      bc,TURBO_SOUND_NEXT_CONTROL
 189+ E1BF ED 79                                out     (c),a
 190+ E1C1 21 83 E1                             ld      hl,SfxChannelVoice
 191+ E1C4 7B                                   ld      a,e
 192+ E1C5 ED 31                                add     hl,a
 193+ E1C7 56                                   ld      d,(hl)
 194+ E1C8 C9                                   ret
 195+ E1C9
 196+ E1C9              ; start every requested effect (SoundFxPending, main memory)
 197+ E1C9 21 A7 85     SfxStartPending:        ld      hl,SoundFxPending
 198+ E1CC 0E 00                                ld      c,0                                 ; c = effect id
 199+ E1CE 7E           .Loop:                  ld      a,(hl)
 200+ E1CF A7                                   and     a
 201+ E1D0 28 0A                                jr      z,.Next
 202+ E1D2 36 00                                ld      (hl),0
 203+ E1D4 C5 E5                                push    bc,,hl
 204+ E1D6 79                                   ld      a,c
 205+ E1D7 CD E4 E1                             call    SfxStart
 206+ E1DA E1 C1                                pop     bc,,hl
 207+ E1DC 23           .Next:                  inc     hl
 208+ E1DD 0C                                   inc     c
 209+ E1DE 79                                   ld      a,c
 210+ E1DF FE 07                                cp      SFXCount
 211+ E1E1 38 EB                                jr      c,.Loop
 212+ E1E3 C9                                   ret
 213+ E1E4
 214+ E1E4              ; a = effect id: on the first free channel (dropped if none)
 215+ E1E4 21 89 E4     SfxStart:               ld      hl,SFXPointerList                   ; de = its data
 216+ E1E7 87                                   add     a,a
 217+ E1E8 ED 31                                add     hl,a
 218+ E1EA 5E                                   ld      e,(hl)
 219+ E1EB 23                                   inc     hl
 220+ E1EC 56                                   ld      d,(hl)
 221+ E1ED 21 8B E1                             ld      hl,SfxChannelLeft                   ; find a free channel
 222+ E1F0 06 08                                ld      b,SfxChannels
 223+ E1F2 0E 00                                ld      c,0
 224+ E1F4 7E           .Find:                  ld      a,(hl)
 225+ E1F5 A7                                   and     a
 226+ E1F6 28 05                                jr      z,.Found
 227+ E1F8 23                                   inc     hl
 228+ E1F9 0C                                   inc     c
 229+ E1FA 10 F8                                djnz    .Find
 230+ E1FC C9                                   ret                                         ; all busy
 231+ E1FD 1A           .Found:                 ld      a,(de)                              ; the step count
 232+ E1FE 77                                   ld      (hl),a
 233+ E1FF 13                                   inc     de                                  ; the first step
 234+ E200 21 93 E1                             ld      hl,SfxChannelPtr
 235+ E203 79                                   ld      a,c
 236+ E204 87                                   add     a,a
 237+ E205 ED 31                                add     hl,a
 238+ E207 73                                   ld      (hl),e
 239+ E208 23                                   inc     hl
 240+ E209 72                                   ld      (hl),d
 241+ E20A 21 A3 E1                             ld      hl,SfxChannelSilence
 242+ E20D 79                                   ld      a,c
 243+ E20E ED 31                                add     hl,a
 244+ E210 36 00                                ld      (hl),0
 245+ E212 C9                                   ret
 246+ E213
 247+ E213              ; one step of every running effect, and silence the ones that ended last frame
 248+ E213 1E 00        SfxStepChannels:        ld      e,0                                 ; e = channel
 249+ E215 21 A3 E1     .Loop:                  ld      hl,SfxChannelSilence
 250+ E218 7B                                   ld      a,e
 251+ E219 ED 31                                add     hl,a
 252+ E21B 7E                                   ld      a,(hl)
 253+ E21C A7                                   and     a
 254+ E21D 28 0F                                jr      z,.NotEnded
 255+ E21F 36 00                                ld      (hl),0
 256+ E221 D5                                   push    de
 257+ E222 CD B5 E1                             call    SfxSelectChannel
 258+ E225 7A                                   ld      a,d                                 ; volume register 8 + voice
 259+ E226 C6 08                                add     a,CHANNEL_A_AMPLITUDE
 260+ E228 57                                   ld      d,a
 261+ E229 AF                                   xor     a
 262+ E22A CD AB E1                             call    SfxWriteReg
 263+ E22D D1                                   pop     de
 264+ E22E 21 8B E1     .NotEnded:              ld      hl,SfxChannelLeft
 265+ E231 7B                                   ld      a,e
 266+ E232 ED 31                                add     hl,a
 267+ E234 7E                                   ld      a,(hl)
 268+ E235 A7                                   and     a
 269+ E236 28 4B                                jr      z,.Next                             ; free
 270+ E238 35                                   dec     (hl)                                ; one fewer to play
 271+ E239 20 08                                jr      nz,.Step
 272+ E23B 21 A3 E1                             ld      hl,SfxChannelSilence                ; the last: silence it next frame
 273+ E23E 7B                                   ld      a,e
 274+ E23F ED 31                                add     hl,a
 275+ E241 36 01                                ld      (hl),1
 276+ E243 21 93 E1     .Step:                  ld      hl,SfxChannelPtr                    ; ix = the step's data
 277+ E246 7B                                   ld      a,e
 278+ E247 87                                   add     a,a
 279+ E248 ED 31                                add     hl,a
 280+ E24A E5                                   push    hl
 281+ E24B 7E                                   ld      a,(hl)
 282+ E24C 23                                   inc     hl
 283+ E24D 66                                   ld      h,(hl)
 284+ E24E 6F                                   ld      l,a
 285+ E24F E5                                   push    hl
 286+ E250 DD E1                                pop     ix
 287+ E252 D5                                   push    de
 288+ E253 CD B5 E1                             call    SfxSelectChannel                    ; d = voice
 289+ E256 7A                                   ld      a,d                                 ; fine tone register 2 * voice
 290+ E257 87                                   add     a,a
 291+ E258 57                                   ld      d,a
 292+ E259 DD 7E 00                             ld      a,(ix+SFXFineOffset)
 293+ E25C CD AB E1                             call    SfxWriteReg
 294+ E25F 14                                   inc     d                                   ; coarse 2 * voice + 1
 295+ E260 DD 7E 01                             ld      a,(ix+SFXCorseOffset)
 296+ E263 E6 0F                                and     $0F
 297+ E265 CD AB E1                             call    SfxWriteReg
 298+ E268 CB 3A                                srl     d                                   ; volume 8 + voice
 299+ E26A 7A                                   ld      a,d
 300+ E26B C6 08                                add     a,CHANNEL_A_AMPLITUDE
 301+ E26D 57                                   ld      d,a
 302+ E26E DD 7E 02                             ld      a,(ix+SFXVolOffset)
 303+ E271 E6 0F                                and     $0F
 304+ E273 CD AB E1                             call    SfxWriteReg
 305+ E276 D1                                   pop     de
 306+ E277 E1                                   pop     hl                                  ; the pointer on a step
 307+ E278 01 03 00                             ld      bc,SFXBlockLength
 308+ E27B DD 09                                add     ix,bc
 309+ E27D DD E5                                push    ix
 310+ E27F C1                                   pop     bc
 311+ E280 71                                   ld      (hl),c
 312+ E281 23                                   inc     hl
 313+ E282 70                                   ld      (hl),b
 314+ E283 1C           .Next:                  inc     e
 315+ E284 7B                                   ld      a,e
 316+ E285 FE 08                                cp      SfxChannels
 317+ E287 38 8C                                jr      c,.Loop
 318+ E289 C9                                   ret
 319+ E28A
 320+ E28A              ; silence and free every effect channel (start up)
 321+ E28A 21 8B E1     SfxReset:               ld      hl,SfxChannelLeft
 322+ E28D 06 20                                ld      b,SfxChannels * 4
 323+ E28F 36 00        .Clear:                 ld      (hl),0
 324+ E291 23                                   inc     hl
 325+ E292 10 FB                                djnz    .Clear
 326+ E294 1E 00                                ld      e,0
 327+ E296 D5           .Silence:               push    de
 328+ E297 CD B5 E1                             call    SfxSelectChannel
 329+ E29A 7A                                   ld      a,d
 330+ E29B C6 08                                add     a,CHANNEL_A_AMPLITUDE
 331+ E29D 57                                   ld      d,a
 332+ E29E AF                                   xor     a
 333+ E29F CD AB E1                             call    SfxWriteReg
 334+ E2A2 D1                                   pop     de
 335+ E2A3 1C                                   inc     e
 336+ E2A4 7B                                   ld      a,e
 337+ E2A5 FE 08                                cp      SfxChannels
 338+ E2A7 38 ED                                jr      c,.Silence
 339+ E2A9 C9                                   ret

   2+ 0000              ; Same signs add the magnitudes (the sign in bit 7 of B carries through), opposite signs subtract the smaller
   3+ 0000              ; magnitude from the larger and take that operand's sign. Never returns -0, overflow is not detected.
   4+ 0000              ; Destroys C and DE.

 114+ 08B6              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 115+ 08B6              ; Ship version of ApplyMyRollAndPitchIX with an extra fraction byte per axis.
 116+ 08B6              ; With roll / pitch rates of only 1..2 / 256 per frame, alpha * x truncated to whole raw units is 0 for any |x| below
 117+ 08B6              ; 128..256 raw, so nearby ships close to the centre of view never moved when the player rolled. Here each axis is
 118+ 08B6              ; worked as a 32 bit 2's complement value (raw * 256 + fraction) and the fraction is kept between frames.
 119+ 08B6              ; Products are truncated towards zero so the Minsky rotation has no drift in either direction.
 120+ 08B6              ; ix = 24 bit lead sign position (x, y, z each lo, hi, sign), iy = 3 fraction bytes (x, y, z). ix and iy preserved
 121+ 08B6              ; Its work variables (RPX32 .. RPSign) are in general_variables.asm, not here: this bank is in slot 0 and writes to
 122+ 08B6              ; $0000-$3FFF can be going to layer 2, so variables in this bank read back as garbage
 123+ 08B6
 124+ 08B6              ; 32 bit 2's complement value at dest = position axis at ix+ixoff (lo, hi, sign) * 256 + fraction at iy+iyoff
 125+ 08B6              RPLoadAxis:                 MACRO   dest, ixoff, iyoff
 126+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      a,(iy+iyoff)
 127+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      (dest),a
 128+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      a,(ix+ixoff)
 129+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      (dest+1),a
 130+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      a,(ix+ixoff+1)
 131+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      (dest+2),a
 132+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      a,(ix+ixoff+2)
 133+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      b,a
 134+ 08B6 ~                                        and     $7F
 135+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      (dest+3),a
 136+ 08B6 ~                                        bit     7,b
 137+ 08B6 ~                                        jr      z,.Positive
 138+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      hl,dest
 139+ 08B6 ~                                        call    RPNeg32
 140+ 08B6 ~            .Positive:
 141+ 08B6                                          ENDM
 142+ 08B6
 143+ 08B6              ; position axis at ix+ixoff and fraction at iy+iyoff = 32 bit 2's complement value at src (src is left as |src|)
 144+ 08B6              RPSaveAxis:                 MACRO   src, ixoff, iyoff
 145+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      b,0
 146+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      a,(src+3)
 147+ 08B6 ~                                        and     a
 148+ 08B6 ~                                        jp      p,.Positive
 149+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      hl,src
 150+ 08B6 ~                                        call    RPNeg32
 151+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      b,$80
 152+ 08B6 ~            .Positive:                  ld      a,(src)
 153+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      (iy+iyoff),a
 154+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      a,(src+1)
 155+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      (ix+ixoff),a
 156+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      a,(src+2)
 157+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      (ix+ixoff+1),a
 158+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      a,(src+3)
 159+ 08B6 ~                                        or      b
 160+ 08B6 ~                                        ld      (ix+ixoff+2),a
 161+ 08B6                                          ENDM

 212+ 0A1B              ; RPProd = (hl) * a / 256, (hl) = 32 bit 2's complement, a = lead sign S7 rotator, truncated towards zero
 213+ 0A1B              ; uses a, bc, de, hl
 214+ 0A1B 32 C5 84     RPMulRot:                   ld      (RPRot),a

 220+ 0A2A A7                                       and     a                       ; .

 309+ 0AA8              ; The orientation vectors are the ship's axes in the player's frame (a vertex is x*side + y*roof + z*nose, see

   4+ 0B5A              ScaleHLD:               MACRO

   6+ 0B5A ~                                    or      l
   7+ 0B5A ~                                    or      d

   9+ 0B5A ~                                    ld      a,1

  15+ 0B5A ~                                    jp      z,.ShiftLoop

  22+ 0B5A ~                                    sla     h
  23+ 0B5A ~                                    sla     l

   5+ 0DB0              ; roof +06 , +07   +08 , +09    +10 , +11

   9+ 0DB0              ;   1. nose = nose / |nose|

   1+ 11C7              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   2+ 11C7              ; Docking for non hostile ships (NormalAI: traders and the like heading for the planet, once the space station is there).
   3+ 11C7              ; In BankMathsBankedFns, paged in at slot 0 by UnivDocking (NormalAI.asm), so it can page the station's universe bank
   4+ 11C7              ; into slot 6 to read its position and nose while the ship's own bank is saved (SaveMMU6 / RestoreMMU6).
   5+ 11C7              ;
   6+ 11C7              ; Each AI turn, from where the ship is now (no phase is kept, so a ship knocked off course just carries on):
   7+ 11C7              ;   * no station: the docking flag is cleared, and the ship goes back to heading for the planet;
   8+ 11C7              ;   * in front of the slot (the station's nose . the unit vector from the station to the ship >= DockConeDot) it
   9+ 11C7              ;     steers for the station itself, slowing to DockSpeed within DockSlowHi; within DockRangeHi it has docked and
  10+ 11C7              ;     leaves the slot list (no explosion, no kill);
  11+ 11C7              ;   * anywhere else it steers for the approach point, DockApproachDistance nose lengths out from the slot, which
  12+ 11C7              ;     brings it round in front of the slot.
  13+ 11C7              ; The station's nose points out of its slot (UnivSetStationInSafeZone puts the slot towards us, as the player's docking
  14+ 11C7              ; test in UpdateUniverseObjects wants). Ships don't collide with the station, so one coming from behind flies through.
  15+ 11C7              ; Tools/test_docking.py
  16+ 11C7              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  17+ 11C7              DockApproachDistance    equ 24                      ; the approach point: the station + its nose (96 = 1.0) * this, 2304 out
  18+ 11C7              DockConeDot             equ 26                      ; in front: the dot (36 = 1.0) at least this, within about 44 degrees
  19+ 11C7              DockRangeHi             equ 2                       ; docked: within 512 of the station on every axis (hi bytes < this)
  20+ 11C7              DockSlowHi              equ $10                     ; within 4096: slow down
  21+ 11C7              DockSpeed               equ 8                       ; to this speed
  22+ 11C7              DockTurnSpeed           equ 3                       ; or this while turning onto the target
  23+ 11C7              DockAlignedDot          equ 30                      ; the nose on the target: its dot with the target's direction >= this
  24+ 11C7

  27+ 11C7              ; this bank is at $0000, where Layer 2's write paging goes while drawing, so a store here could land in the screen
